newsitem.title: UK: UK brewers soar, market laps up consumer stocks.
newsitem.headline: UK brewers soar, market laps up consumer stocks.

text.p: Shares in brewing companies rose sharply on Friday as investors crowded into consumer stocks with a high proportion of domestic sales, dealers and analysts said.

"After rates rose less than people expected yesterday and with the pound still rising the brewers look very interesting to investors, particularly considering the way they've underperformed over the last year," said one specialist salesman.
Whitbread Plc put on 35p to 828p, Scottish & Newcastle Plc gained 35p also to 741-1/2p and Bass Plc rose 12p to 821p.
"Bass has done really well over the last week already and the other two are just catching up with the trend," said the salesman.
On Thursday, the Bank of England raised base rates by a quarter point to 6.75 percent with the market expecting as much as a half point rise.
Sterling earlier struck a six-year high at 2.98 marks and traded at its highest since January 10 against the dollar at $1.6975.
